{{Quote|Battle platforms can destroy, starfleets can blockade, but only the army can take and hold the ground. Without the ground, all your fancy spaceships will wither and rot.|General Crix Madine|<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
The '''Alliance Army''' was a military branch containing the ground forces of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]], consisting of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] controlled by [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]], and various [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]] controlled by a [[Sector commander/Legends|Sector Commander]]. It was later replaced by the [[New Republic Army]].

The Alliance Army was founded and operated until the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] as a guerrilla force aimed at tying down and harassing an enemy force rather than meeting that enemy in open battle. An Alliance Army force could expect to be outnumbered in any given battle it fought against the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], and as such its tactics were geared towards 'hit and run' rather than a conventional battle.

==History==
The Alliance Army was formed after the establishment of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="TFUn" /> It was the ground forces of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]], consisting of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] controlled by [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]], and various [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]] controlled by a [[Sector commander/Legends|Sector Commander]]. It was formed from some of the early resistance groups to fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The Alliance Army was far from being as large as it's main opponent, the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

Following the failure of [[Operation Domino]], the Army was supplanted by the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] as the primary Rebel fighting force.<ref name="Warfare" />

The [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] was one of the few ground engagements in which the Alliance Army fought in numbers and used conventional defense tactics, and in most of its battles operated as guerrilla raiding force, harassing and tying up Imperial forces.

The Alliance Army combated [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army's]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Alliance troops found their light weaponry relatively useless against the heavily armored Imperial vehicles. The most effective weapon they used to combat the Imperial walkers were arguably the [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> The Alliance Army's role during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] was mostly a commando operation, in which a small strike team was deployed to destroy the energy shield generator protecting the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]].

The Alliance Army was operated until the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and was later replaced by the [[New Republic Army]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Soldiers==
{{Quote|What's the matter? You guys wanna live forever? Move it out!|A [[Unidentified Rebel sergeant|Rebel]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]|<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)" />}}
[[File:Training_exercise-GAW.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rebel Alliance soldiers in training session]]
The Alliance Army's infantry was formed partly of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]], and [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] divisions. Organizations formed of highly trained commandos and agents, who performed a series of guerrilla attacks throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] with the aim of undermining, pilfering from and ultimately destroying the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The rest of the Alliance Army's infantry was made up of [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]] with the vast majority of the personnel being [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]].

===Command structure===
[[File:Hoth_trenches.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Alliance Army personnel preparing for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assault at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].]]
The Rebel Alliance Army and Sector Force had a largely standardized command structure. While it could vary from sector to sector, most Sector Forces used the following organization:<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

*'''[[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]]''': Second-in-command in a squad of nine troops. The corporal was the senior-most trooper.<ref name="RECG" />
*'''[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]]''': Commanded a squad of 9 troopers.<ref name="RECG" />
*'''[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]''': Commanded a platoon that consisted of 4 squads (36 troops).<ref name="RECG" />
*'''[[Captain/Legends|Captain]]''': Commanded a company that was made up of 4 platoons (144 troops) .<ref name="RECG" />
*'''[[Major/Legends|Major]]''': Commanded a battalion composed of 4 companies (576 troops).<ref name="RECG" />
*'''[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]]''': Commanded a regiment that was made up of 4 battalions (2,304 troops). Occasionally commanded brigades which was composed of 4 regiments (9,216 troops). The colonel was occasionally referred to as a regimental commander.<ref name="RECG" />
*'''[[General/Legends|General]]''': Commanded brigades which consisted of 4 regiments (9,216 troops) or corps which was formed by 4 brigades (36,864 troops). A sector's most senior general could also command a [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]].<ref name="RECG" />

Above the generals were the senior generals who usually held the title of [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]] commander, followed by the [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]] [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander (Alliance/Republic)]].<ref name="RECG" />

In the Navy, the rank of [[Petty Officer/Legends|Petty officer]], [[Chief Petty Officer/Legends|Chief Petty Officer]], [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] were the ranks beneath the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] (with [[Admiral of the Fleet/Legends|Admiral of the Fleet]] as the [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander (Alliance/Republic)]] of the combined [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]). Beneath the officers were the ordinary crewmen, generally referred to as [[Deckman|Deckmen]].<ref name="RECG" />

==Tactics==
Compared to the forces of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the Alliance's ground forces were woefully outmatched in numbers of troops, vehicles, warships and material.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> Because of this, Alliance commanders were taught to follow [[Madine's Rules of War]]. Striking the enemy at his weakest points, destroying their morale and outsmarting enemy commanders were seen as the best way for the Rebels to achieve victory during offensive operations.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />

The same principle was applied to defensive operations. Army units were often tasked to provide cover while important Rebel assets escaped and other temporary holding actions; extended defensive battles would always result in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] eventually overwhelming them with superior numbers.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> A form of mobile defense was encouraged, whereby ground was given up when necessary in order to lure overextended Imperial forces into a trap. The [[Battle of Tiems]] was a classic example of this method and later used as an lesson to teach new Army commanders.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />

Tactically the Alliance Army fought as a combined arms force, utilizing infantry, artillery, armor (Combat Assault Vehicles or CAVs), scout units, ground transports (Light Mechanical Vehicles or LMVs), and air support (Sub-Atmospheric Craft or SAC). Because of shortages within the Rebellion, however, not all of these elements were always present on a battlefield.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> Reflecting the Alliance Army's way of fighting, most Rebel vehicles tended to be lighter and faster than their Imperial counterparts in order to outmaneuver them and either attack weak points or retreat in the face of overwhelming firepower.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />

Troopers on board the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] were seen using a two-man buddy system for point and cover fire as a standard tactic.<ref name="VG3">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp04.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 4: Artoo's Mission}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Alliance Army appeared in the first of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' media, the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].

The Alliance Army featured in the [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] campaign in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.
